content_preview.title: Antora Energy Closes $550 Million Series C to Scale Carbon-Block Thermal Battery Manufacturing
content_preview.summary: Antora Energy raised $550 million to expand production of its carbon-block thermal batteries and build a second U.S. factory, following a 5 GWh South Dakota deployment.
